title: Harbor Seed Fund - investor notes
text:
Author: **Maya Chen** · Contact: Lena Fischer, Principal, Harbor Seed Fund
## Timeline
- <mention-date start="2026-09-24"/> First intro call with Lena
- <mention-date start="2026-10-06"/> Pitch to Harbor Seed Fund partners (Maya and Wop)
- <mention-date start="2026-10-30"/> Lena presents Pairly at the partner meeting
## What they liked
- Matching by free time and study style, not just by course
- A clear campus-by-campus growth plan with student ambassadors
## What they asked for
- Beta sign-ups and weekly active students
- How many groups actually met at least twice
- Plan for the next two campuses
## Numbers we sent (Westbrook beta)
- 214 students signed up, 131 active weekly (61%)
- 58 study groups created, 37 met at least twice
- Next campuses: Lakeside College (January), Crestview State (March)
## Next steps
- [ ] Send fresh numbers after the Nov 2 launch
- [ ] Prepare a one-page summary of the beta feedback for Lena
